title: FinServ model sourcing playbook: vendor economics, latency thresholds & compliance gating
creator: Olivia Chen
description:
Problem: Sales and Solutions Engineering are encountering long evaluation cycles when customers in regulated finance verticals request model options that simultaneously meet latency (<150ms p50 for conversational agents), deterministic outputs for compliance audits, and KMS-backed key separation. There is no documented playbook for evaluating vendor models against these combined constraints.

Goal: Produce an operational playbook that the PM + Solutions + Procurement teams can use to rapidly assess, classify, and recommend model variants for FinServ customers. Deliverables include: a scoring rubric (latency/cost/quantization/compatibility/compliance), a prioritized vendor short-list per capability bucket, an operational checklist for Private/Dedicated deployment gating, and a template SoW for procurement.

Scope: Focus on open and semi-open model vendors that Redwood can realistically host or route to within 3 months. Include onboarding checklist for Dedicated and Private modes and sample benchmarks for embeddings and chat flows typical of KYC and contract summarization workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented and reviewed by legal and security
Top-6 vendor short-list with benchmark results for latency and cost per 1k tokens
Private/Dedicated gating checklist with KMS and audit-log verification steps
Procurement SoW template and recommended contractual clauses for model availability SLA
success_metrics: Reduce FinServ evaluation cycle from avg 9 weeks to <=4 weeks
Increase closure rate on FinServ Dedicated deals by 15% within 3 months of playbook rollout
First-response benchmark packet delivered to SEs within 48 hours for new FinServ prospects
proposed_workstreams: Landscape scan: enumerate vendor models and gather licensing constraints
Benchmarks: run standardized FinServ prompt set for latency/p95/p50/cost
Compliance mapping: collect KMS/HSM, SOC2/ISO attestation data and audit log capabilities
Gating checklist: define minimums for Private/Dedicated acceptance and go/no-go
Procurement templates: create SoW and SLA clauses and a quick-negotiation playbook
